title: Murderhost of Halfa vs Kishomon Company
lede:
The Murderhost of Halfa won 30-27 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6, reaching the target exactly with all three objectives in the last Cleanup Phase.

Kishomon Company led 20-17 after four rounds, but its melee and artillery could not keep the Murderhost off the objectives, and the swing was Round 4: a Countercharge put the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery in front of Furyforged Berserkers 1 at AR 33, and its death paid ASSASSINATION 4 VP.
result_line: Murderhost of Halfa win 30-27 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Murderhost of Halfa, an all-melee army, set up on rows 12 and 13 in front of its HQ at (7,13): The Blooded Hegemon with Furyforged Berserkers 1 at (6,12), Furyforged Berserkers 2 at (10,12), the Avatar of Wrath at (9,12), both Hounds of Satan on the wings at (4,13) and (11,13) and three Cultist Zealots at (3,12), (4,12) and (7,12). Kishomon Company set up on rows 1 to 3 around its HQ at (7,1): the Taichou with the Oni Samurai at (11,2), the War Onmyoji with Ashigaru Riflemen 1 at (9,2), Ashigaru Riflemen 2 and 3 at (3,2) and (5,2), the Armored Gashadokuro at (5,1), the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery at (3,1) and the Kitsune Shinobi, HIDDEN, at (1,3), with three Shikigami Tokens behind them for the War Onmyoji's Paper Body. Kishomon's rifles and the Gun Battery had to thin the Murderhost before it arrived; the Murderhost had to get into melee. The Murderhost won the Roll Off for Round 1 Priority.

1.title: Kishomon takes the centre and the left

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Murderhost, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION for Kishomon. Secondaries kept: ASSASSINATION and VIGILANT WATCH. Both sides spent 2 CP on Double Time, for Cultist Zealots 3 and the Oni Samurai, and neither bought a move. Kishomon spent 1 Regalia on YATA NO KAGAMI (an AP mark that touched no attack) and 2 on YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA for the Gun Battery.

Everything Advanced. The Oni Samurai with the Taichou and Ashigaru Riflemen 1 with the War Onmyoji reached the centre at (8,7) and (8,6); Ashigaru Riflemen 2 and the Armored Gashadokuro took the left at (1,6) and (2,6). The Murderhost came up behind: Cultist Zealots 3 and 1 to (6,6) and (6,7), the Hounds of Satan to (6,8) and (7,9), Furyforged Berserkers 1 with the Hegemon to (9,9); the Avatar of Wrath went right to (12,7).
Only the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery could act: its Type 31 High Explosive, raised by YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA, took 6 off Cultist Zealots 1 (20 to 14).
Kishomon won the centre on OC 18 vs 5 and the left on OC 13 vs 0 (5 VP); the Avatar of Wrath held the right alone (2). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Murderhost 1 for contesting the centre. 3-5.

Kishomon's Double Time sent the Kitsune Shinobi to (12,4) (2 CP, out of reach without it); the Murderhost's Double Time for Furyforged Berserkers 1 bought nothing. Secondaries kept: COMMAND AUTHORITY and FORWARD PRESENCE.

Furyforged Berserkers 1 and the Hegemon charged the Oni Samurai and the Taichou at (8,8); Hounds of Satan 2 charged into the same block at (7,6). Cultist Zealots 1 and 3 charged Ashigaru Riflemen 1 and the War Onmyoji from (8,5) and (7,5). On the left the Armored Gashadokuro charged Cultist Zealots 2, which broke away to (6,10). Ashigaru Riflemen 3 walked into the Avatar's Overwatch (2, BURNED).

The Oni Samurai struck first and destroyed Hounds of Satan 2 (10), then took ground to (7,6), out of reach of the Berserkers that had charged it, so Furyforged Berserkers 1 and the Hegemon had nothing to hit. Cultist Zealots 3 rolled 13 hits on Ashigaru Riflemen 1 (Zealous Charge, 18 damage) and Cultist Zealots 1 finished them, putting the War Onmyoji to 1 HP; Paper Body spent Shikigami Token 1 in its place. The Kitsune Shinobi JINXED the Avatar of Wrath, which was shot by Ashigaru Riflemen 3 and Insatiable Rage's compelled charge pulled it off the right objective to (11,6). BURNED took 6 more off Ashigaru Riflemen 3.

The centre tied (OC 8 vs 8, three units each) and nobody held the right; the Armored Gashadokuro held the left (2). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Murderhost 3, the centre being no longer Kishomon's; STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid Kishomon 1 for the Hounds killed in an Objective Area. 6-8.

3.title: Kishomon holds all three, and the Berserkers feed

feed.text: The Murderhost's Double Time on the Hegemon bought nothing. Kishomon spent 2 CP on Rally Cry for the War Onmyoji and 2 Regalia on YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA for the Oni Samurai. Both kept COORDINATED PUSH; COMMAND AUTHORITY and VIGILANT WATCH expired.

Cultist Zealots 2 charged the War Onmyoji at (9,7). Ashigaru Riflemen 3 and Hounds of Satan 1 both failed Fall Back tests and broke away in disorder. The Kitsune Shinobi stepped onto the right objective at (13,7) and the Avatar of Wrath charged it there. Furyforged Berserkers 1 and the Hegemon charged Ashigaru Riflemen 2 at (5,6).

Furyforged Berserkers 1 rolled 14 hits and destroyed Ashigaru Riflemen 2 (20), ten models, which gave them ten Blood Frenzy stacks (+1 AR each to the end of Round 4). The Oni Samurai, with YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA's bonus, destroyed Cultist Zealots 1 (14). The Avatar missed the Kitsune Shinobi; the Taichou took 4 off Cultist Zealots 3; Cultist Zealots 2's 14 hits on the War Onmyoji were absorbed twice by Paper Body (Shikigami Tokens 2 and 3). Furyforged Berserkers 2, shot by the Gun Battery, charged under Insatiable Rage and took the Oni Samurai from 12 to 6.
Kishomon held all three: the centre on OC 6 vs 4, the left on OC 3 and the right on OC 3 vs 2 (7 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Murderhost 2. 8-15.
Kishomon spent 2 CP on Rally Cry for the War Onmyoji and held 4; the Murderhost passed with 2. Both kept FOCUSED FIRE.

Furyforged Berserkers 1 declared a charge, and Kishomon answered with Countercharge via the HQ (3 CP): the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery charged the Berserkers and the Hegemon from (3,1) to (4,4), and the Berserkers' charge was cancelled. The War Onmyoji, out of Shikigami Tokens, failed its Fall Back test and was destroyed by the disorder. Cultist Zealots 2 charged the Kitsune Shinobi at (12,6), which broke away to (13,8); Furyforged Berserkers 2 broke away in disorder to (5,9).

The Oni Samurai drank the Sake of Mount Oe for 3 HP. Then Furyforged Berserkers 1 swung at the Gun Battery with AR 33 (eleven per model, ten of it Blood Frenzy) doubled by Dual Wield: 50 hits, and the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery was destroyed. A MONSTER: ASSASSINATION complete, +4 VP. The Avatar's Red Dragon's Breath took 1 off the Kitsune Shinobi and BURNED it.

Kishomon held the centre on OC 7 vs 4 and the left on OC 3 (5 VP). The Avatar of Wrath and Cultist Zealots 2 took the right on OC 2 vs 2 (2 VP), and because the right had been Kishomon's, BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3. 17-20.

5.title: The Hegemon's block takes the centre; level at 23

feed.text: The Murderhost spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition, Cultist Troopers at (7,12); Kishomon spent 2 on Double Time for the Taichou (bought nothing) and 2 Regalia on YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA for the Oni Samurai. The Murderhost picked the right objective for Kishomon's TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and kept PROBING STRIKE. Both FOCUSED FIREs expired.

The Oni Samurai and the Taichou charged Hounds of Satan 1 at (7,8), which broke away to (6,6). Furyforged Berserkers 1 and the Hegemon charged the Taichou, the Oni Samurai and Ashigaru Riflemen 3 onto (7,7). Cultist Zealots 3 charged Ashigaru Riflemen 3 at (8,5) and Cultist Zealots 2 the Kitsune Shinobi at (13,7).

The Oni Samurai attacked Furyforged Berserkers 1, and the Hegemon struck first at INI 11: 5 into the Taichou, which survived on 1 HP through the DRAGON HAORI. The Berserkers' 16 hits did 3 to the Oni Samurai, which did 6 back (8 to 2). Cultist Zealots 2 destroyed the Kitsune Shinobi (3). The Taichou's Raien Twin Katanas finished Furyforged Berserkers 1 (2) and BURNED and PARALYZED the Hegemon. Cultist Zealots 3 destroyed Ashigaru Riflemen 3 (3).

The Murderhost took the centre on OC 7 vs 5 and kept the right (5 VP); the Armored Gashadokuro kept the left (2). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1, its last VP before its 10 VP cap; STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid Kishomon 1 for Furyforged Berserkers 1. 23-23.

6.title: The Cultist Troopers take the left for 30

feed.text: The Murderhost spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Cultist Troopers (bought nothing). Kishomon's Rally Cry via the Taichou for the Oni Samurai, which stood in the enemy half, completed COMMAND AUTHORITY (+2).
Kishomon did not move. The Cultist Troopers charged the Armored Gashadokuro on the left at (2,8); Cultist Zealots 2 and 3 settled on the right and the centre.
The Armored Gashadokuro's Rail Girder took the Cultist Troopers from 20 to 8 after their 3 hits did nothing. The Blooded Hegemon killed the Oni Samurai (6).

The Murderhost held all three: the centre on OC 7 vs 1, the left on OC 4 vs 3, the Cultist Troopers' 8 HP against the Gashadokuro, and the right on OC 2 (7 VP) for exactly 30. STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid Kishomon 2, because the capped BREAK THEIR HOLD scored nothing that round. 30-27.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Murderhost of Halfa scored 16 objective VP, 12 of them in the last two rounds, 10 from BREAK THEIR HOLD (its cap, reached in Round 5) and 4 from ASSASSINATION. Kishomon Company scored 21 objective VP, holding something every round to Round 5 and all three in Round 3, 4 from STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION and 2 from COMMAND AUTHORITY. It kept six secondaries and completed one. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Murderhost for every round it stood in Kishomon's Objective Areas, so Kishomon's lead never grew past 7 VP (15-8 after Round 3).

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Avatar of Wrath scored 10.0 VP, the most in the battle, by standing on the right objective in Rounds 1, 4, 5 and 6, though it did only 5 damage. Furyforged Berserkers 1 did 31 damage and won the battle's biggest single fight: ten Ashigaru killed in Round 3 gave them ten Blood Frenzy stacks, and the Gun Battery that countercharged them in Round 4 met AR 33. Cultist Zealots 3, 10 RP, did 21 damage, 18 of it into Ashigaru Riflemen 1 on one Zealous Charge. The Blooded Hegemon (70 RP) did 11 damage and killed the Oni Samurai in Round 6 but stood idle in four rounds (in three of them its best action, Champion of The Pit, scored 0).

For Kishomon, the Oni Samurai did 30 damage and killed Hounds of Satan 2 and Cultist Zealots 1 (9.5 VP). The Armored Gashadokuro held the left for five rounds (9.0 VP, 8 of them hinged on it) while idle in five of them, which was its job; it lost the left in Round 6 by one OC to the Murderhost's late Cultist Troopers. The three Ashigaru squads, Kishomon's OC, were destroyed in melee in Rounds 2, 3 and 5.

{{chart:attrition}}

What Kishomon could not do

Its secondaries asked for things its army did not do. VIGILANT WATCH wanted an Overwatch from an Objective Area and Kishomon fired no Overwatch all battle; FORWARD PRESENCE wanted a unit within 3 squares of the enemy HQ; COORDINATED PUSH, FOCUSED FIRE and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET expired or stayed open. A rifle army that holds and shoots scores none of those, and the Murderhost's charges kept its shooters in melee from Round 2. STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION's second clause also turned on the Murderhost: BREAK THEIR HOLD hit its cap in Round 5, scored nothing in Round 6, and paid Kishomon 2.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, the army and the record

  • Round 4, the Countercharge: Kishomon spent 3 CP to send its Gun Battery, a MONSTER and an artillery piece, into Furyforged Berserkers 1 while they carried ten Blood Frenzy stacks. It died to 50 hits, and ASSASSINATION paid 4 VP in a battle that ended 30-27; without those 4 the Murderhost would have stood on 26 after Round 6. The commands-and-abilities record prices the Countercharge at "nothing - no change" though it cancelled the Berserkers' charge and started that fight.
  • Round 2, Take Ground: the Oni Samurai's Take Ground to (7,6) after killing Hounds of Satan 2 left the Furyforged Berserkers 1 and the Hegemon, which had charged it, with no target. That is the rule as written (a consolidation move with no engagement check), and it cost the Murderhost an Action Phase from 95 RP.
  • Round 2, the Avatar of Wrath: Insatiable Rage's compelled charge after Ashigaru Riflemen 3 shot it took the Avatar off the right objective, which nobody held that round and Kishomon took in Round 3. The army's rule, not an AI choice.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by charge-planning probes: Kishomon's HQ in Round 2, the Murderhost's HQ and Furyforged Berserkers 2 in Round 5, and the Oni Samurai in Round 4 are listed as "held" against engagers at least two squares away.
  • Six of the seven Double Times (all four of the Murderhost's, and Kishomon's in Rounds 1 and 5) bought no move.

On the evidence the army mattered more than the AI: the Murderhost's melee wiped Kishomon's OC squads one by one while BREAK THEIR HOLD paid it for contesting. The Countercharge was the AI's worst single choice, and it came in a 3 VP finish.

closing: Kishomon Company led on VP for four rounds, but every round it had to fight the Murderhost for them, and every fight cost it a squad. The Countercharge in Round 4 gave Furyforged Berserkers 1 a MONSTER to kill, and the Murderhost took all three objectives in Round 6 to finish on exactly 30.
